exposure: Blood resistance S/D value of uterine artery in early pregnancy
outcome: Maternal serum biomarkers (d-dimers, platelet aggregation rates)
finding: Low-dose aspirin significantly reduced the incidence of preeclampsia and early-onset preeclampsia in a dose-dependent manner.
mod_finding: Low-dose aspirin use was associated with reduced rates of postpartum hemorrhage and cesarean section.
